jobs.title: Financial Planning & Analysis Manager
jobs.description:
The Company:

Outschool’s mission is to inspire kids to love learning. In our fast-changing world, the traditional educational system struggles to meet the diverse and evolving needs of young learners. Outschool reimagines this system, offering flexible and engaging learning experiences as a supplement and alternative to traditional education. By connecting learners with a global community of teachers and peers through our online platform, we make learning personal, dynamic, and deeply human.

We've made significant strides since launching our marketplace of live online classes in 2017. Finding initial success with secular homeschoolers, we then expanded to enrichment learning to meet the needs of a wider audience, growing our business 16x since 2019. Post-pandemic, we have evolved our platform to power academic learning, incorporated AI, and have begun to grow our international community. We're proud to have served over 1.5M passionate learners with more than $100M in annual bookings.

Driving disruptive, positive change in education is rewarding and hard. Outschool team members are encouraged to challenge themselves, take risks, and grow in their careers. We look for talented people whose sense of urgency, innate curiosity, and determination to drive impact will help Outschool achieve outsized results in pursuit of our mission. We invite you to be part of an ambitious team dedicated to ensuring every learner can navigate the future with curiosity, resilience, and a love of learning.

The Role

Outschool is growing its Finance team and is looking for a driven FP&A and Strategic Finance Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated FP&A experience setting and owning a budget, maintaining a forecast, building financial & operating models, and has a proven track record of working closely with business partners to help make sound financial decisions. You will join Outschool as a critical member of the team as we build and expand the sophistication of our financial processes which will enable us to effectively scale our business.

You’ll work collaboratively with members of every team at Outschool as a strategic finance partner. You'll partner in our budgeting and reporting process and help our team to measure performance. You ideally have experience in assisting in the development of comprehensive budgets and an ability to help leaders become more fluent in financial strategy.

Core Responsibilities:

 - Support our company-wide budgeting and forecasting processes in collaboration with stakeholders across the organization in order to drive accountability and exceptional results

 - Assist in maintaining a forward-looking financial model that accurately predicts performance and can be used to drive long-term growth

 - Partner in the tracking of financial & operational performance metrics that allow Outschool to scale and grow

 - Provide reporting and data-driven insights to our team, board, and investors on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis

 - Collaborate on key growth initiatives by assisting our marketing leads to scale new buyer acquisition and track customer acquisition costs (CAC), as well as be a trusted partner to our supply-side and international growth teams

Desired Experience & Skills:

 - 5+ years of experience scaling FP&A efforts, owning budgets, and managing key stakeholder relationships

 - A track record of building financial and operating models for a growth-stage business

 - Demonstrated experience shaping and implementing financial strategies for public and/or private companies

 - An aptitude and motivation to frame finances in the context of mission and social impact

 - Exceptional communicator with ability to present complex concepts, recommendations and analyses to business leaders in a clear, concise and actionable manner

 - An ability to think differently and the bravery to act on it. You push against the status quo because you see the gap between the opportunities of the future, emerging finance trends, and current practices

 - Experience building materials and providing detailed reports and metrics to leaders

 - A data-centric mind with an ability to dive deep into the details of our business to make the right judgment calls

 - The ideal candidate has a sense of urgency to their work, and brings a proactive approach to identifying areas of opportunity for the Finance team and overall business

 - Areas of experience that will be essential for success in this role include Revenue Forecasting and work supporting the analysis of LTV/CAC while partnering with our Marketing team

Other Considerations:

 - A plus if you have an investment banking background

 - A plus if you have experience and understanding of large-scale online marketplaces or business

 - A plus if you have experience in both B2C and B2B companies

Compensation:

Outschool recruits across the US and Canada, and sets employee salaries to reflect local compensation and cost of living. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for equity and benefits. Additional details are provided during the interview process.

US Tier 3: All other cities and states

At Outschool, we believe that taking care of one another enables us to do our best work. To us that means:

 - Wellness: Annual wellness stipend, access to coaching & therapy, and pet wellness plans.

Outschool is expanding the ways families can access and use education funding to support their children's learning. This hands-on role will initially focus on Education Savings Accounts (ESAs), with opportunities to expand into the Federal Scholarship Tax Credit (FSTC), scholarship-granting organizations (SGOs), and other state and federal education funding programs.

You'll serve as the primary day-to-day operational contact for funding partners, including ESA wallet providers, scholarship-granting organizations, and program administrators. You'll manage the processes supporting transactions, payments, reimbursements, refunds, and reconciliations while coordinating with Product and Engineering to maintain reliable partner integrations.

You'll work closely with our Public Funding Strategy Director and Business Development leadership to support new funding opportunities, operationalize partnerships, and ensure new programs are ready to launch and scale. You'll also collaborate with Finance, Customer Experience, Legal, and Compliance to resolve issues, improve workflows, and deliver a seamless experience for families.

We're looking for a hands-on problem solver who combines operational rigor, technical aptitude, attention to detail, and strong partner relationship skills. You'll be someone who takes ownership of problems, anticipates issues, and continuously looks for ways to make operations more reliable and efficient.

 - Manage transactions and reimbursements: Oversee operational processes for purchases, payments, reimbursements, refunds, cancellations, and reconciliations. Work with Finance and Customer Experience to investigate and resolve discrepancies and exceptions.

 - Maintain partner integrations: Coordinate with Product and Engineering to support reliable integrations with wallet providers and funding platforms, troubleshoot technical issues, and help test and implement system improvements.

 - Improve operational processes: Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and scale operations through automation and better tools.

 - Ensure operational readiness and compliance: Work with Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Operations to implement partner and program requirements, maintain documented procedures, and support ongoing participation in funding programs.

 - Coordinate cross-functional issue resolution: Proactively identify operational risks and work with internal teams and external partners to resolve issues before they materially affect families or program performance.

 - Monitor operational performance: Track transaction success rates, refund processing times, reconciliation accuracy, integration reliability, and partner issue resolution. Use performance data to identify recurring problems and drive improvements.

 - Demonstrated ability to manage complex operational workflows, troubleshoot issues, and improve processes.

 - Comfort working with technical systems, integrations, transaction data, and operational reporting.

 - Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage competing priorities.

 - Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, Finance, Customer Experience, and other functional teams.

 - Strong communication skills and a practical, service-oriented approach to partner relationships and problem-solving.

 - Experience improving operational efficiency through process optimization, automation, or technology.

 - Experience supporting third-party platform integrations or API-based workflows.

The Role

Outschool is focused on strengthening and expanding its core marketplace while developing new educational programs and services that meet the evolving needs of families. We're looking for a Strategy Director, Marketplace & New Programs to help shape our marketplace growth strategy and turn new business opportunities into meaningful revenue growth.

In this role, you'll develop a deep understanding of Outschool's marketplace performance, customer behavior, economics, and underlying growth drivers. Working closely with Product, Growth, Marketing, Finance, and Operations, you'll identify opportunities to strengthen the existing business, improve our competitive position, and accelerate sustainable growth.

You'll also continuously evaluate the competitive landscape, emerging markets, and evolving customer needs to identify opportunities for new programs, bundled learning experiences, specialized services, and business models. You'll develop business cases, define new offerings, and establish a prioritized roadmap for marketplace expansion.

This is a strategic, commercially accountable, and execution-oriented role. You'll serve as the central business lead for new marketplace program initiatives, coordinating cross-functional development, launch, and commercialization. You'll establish clear revenue and enrollment objectives, monitor performance, and work across teams to ensure new offerings deliver measurable results.

You'll also collaborate closely with our Public Funding & Accredited Programs Strategy Director to identify opportunities that bring together marketplace offerings, public funding, and accredited educational models.

We're looking for someone with exceptional analytical capabilities, strong commercial judgment, and an entrepreneurial mindset who can connect deep business insights with practical execution and successful new programs.

Core Responsibilities:

 - Understand and shape marketplace growth strategy: Develop a deep understanding of Outschool's core business, including revenue, gross merchandise value (GMV), customer acquisition, conversion, retention, educator supply, and marketplace economics. Help establish the strategic priorities and multi-year roadmap for marketplace growth and new programs.

 - Identify opportunities to strengthen the core business: Analyze customer behavior, category performance, pricing, unit economics, competitive dynamics, and growth drivers. Work with Product, Growth, Marketing, Finance, and Operations to identify business challenges and recommend initiatives that improve marketplace performance and competitiveness.

 - Evaluate new markets and growth opportunities: Analyze the competitive landscape, emerging education trends, underserved customer needs, and evolving business models. Assess total addressable markets (TAM), positioning, pricing, and revenue potential to identify attractive opportunities for expansion.

 - Develop business cases and investment recommendations: Build financial models, revenue projections, and business cases for new programs, services, and market opportunities. Evaluate build, buy, and partner strategies and recommend investment priorities.

 - Design new educational offerings: Lead the strategy and commercial design of new programs, bundled learning experiences, specialized services, and marketplace business models. Define target audiences, value propositions, positioning, packaging, pricing, delivery models, and financial objectives.

 - Lead cross-functional program development: Serve as the central business lead for new program initiatives, working closely with Product, Growth, Marketing, Business Development, Finance, and Operations to translate concepts into business requirements, development plans, and launch-ready offerings.

 - Drive program launches and revenue growth: Establish clear revenue forecasts, enrollment targets, launch milestones, and performance measures for new programs. Coordinate launches, monitor commercial results, and work with functional teams to optimize offerings, pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategies.

 - Collaborate across growth initiatives: Partner with the Public Funding & Accredited Programs Strategy Director to identify opportunities to integrate marketplace offerings with publicly funded, accredited, and tuition-based educational programs, ensuring clear ownership and coordinated execution.

 - Drive accountability and strategic decisions: Monitor performance of new initiatives, identify opportunities for expansion or improvement, and recommend continued investment, modifications, or discontinuation based on results. Present marketplace insights, business cases, strategic recommendations, and performance updates to executive leadership.

Desired Experience & Skills:

 - 8+ years of experience in business strategy, growth strategy, product strategy, or new business development within consumer marketplaces, education, technology, or services businesses, including at least 3 years of experience leading a team or holding P&L responsibility.

 - Strong analytical capabilities and demonstrated experience evaluating business performance, customer behavior, unit economics, and drivers of revenue growth.

 - Demonstrated success identifying strategic opportunities and translating market and competitive insights into successful business initiatives.

 - Experience developing business cases, financial models, market assessments, pricing strategies, and investment recommendations.

 - Proven experience taking new products, programs, services, or business initiatives from opportunity identification through development, launch, and revenue growth.

 - Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align teams, influence priorities, and drive execution without direct reporting authority.

 - Experience working closely with Product, Growth, Marketing, Business Development, Finance, and Operations.

 - Entrepreneurial mindset, strong commercial judgment, and a demonstrated ability to translate strategy into measurable business results.

Other Considerations:

 - Experience with consumer marketplaces, two-sided platforms, or educational services businesses.

 - Experience analyzing marketplace dynamics, customer acquisition, retention, provider supply, and category economics.

 - Experience developing bundled offerings, new service categories, subscriptions, or innovative commercial models.

 - Experience launching and scaling new products, programs, or business lines within an established organization.

jobs.title: Strategy Director, Public Funding & Accredited Programs
jobs.description:
The Company:

Outschool’s mission is to inspire kids to love learning. In our fast-changing world, the traditional educational system struggles to meet the diverse and evolving needs of young learners. Outschool reimagines this system, offering flexible and engaging learning experiences as a supplement and alternative to traditional education. By connecting learners with a global community of teachers and peers through our online platform, we make learning personal, dynamic, and deeply human.

We've made significant strides since launching our marketplace of live online classes in 2017. Finding initial success with secular homeschoolers, we then expanded to enrichment learning to meet the needs of a wider audience, growing our business 16x since 2019. Post-pandemic, we have evolved our platform to power academic learning, incorporated AI, and have begun to grow our international community. We're proud to have served over 1.5M passionate learners with more than $100M in annual bookings.

Driving disruptive, positive change in education is rewarding and hard. Outschool team members are encouraged to challenge themselves, take risks, and grow in their careers. We look for talented people whose sense of urgency, innate curiosity, and determination to drive impact will help Outschool achieve outsized results in pursuit of our mission. We invite you to be part of an ambitious team dedicated to ensuring every learner can navigate the future with curiosity, resilience, and a love of learning.

The Role

Outschool is expanding how families access and pay for education, creating new opportunities through public funding, accredited schools, tuition-based programs, and flexible learning pathways. We're looking for a Strategy Director, Public Funding & Accredited Programs to identify and develop these opportunities and turn them into meaningful revenue growth.

In this role, you'll analyze markets, competitors, and customer needs to identify attractive growth opportunities, develop new educational program concepts and business models, and establish the strategy and roadmap for bringing them to market. Your work will span Education Savings Accounts (ESAs), the Federal Scholarship Tax Credit, state education funding programs, accredited schools, and tuition-based educational offerings.

You'll work closely with Product, Business Development, Marketing, School Leadership, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Operations to translate opportunities into differentiated programs and successful launches. You'll also partner with the team responsible for Outschool's core marketplace strategy to identify opportunities to combine existing offerings with new funding and accredited education models.

This is a strategic, commercially focused, and execution-oriented role. You'll help drive initiatives from market assessment and business case development through program design, launch, and growth, establishing clear revenue objectives and working across teams to deliver measurable results.

Core Responsibilities:

 - Identify and evaluate growth opportunities: Analyze market demand, customer segments, competitive offerings, education funding trends, and emerging educational models. Assess total addressable markets (TAM), pricing, unit economics, and revenue potential to prioritize opportunities.

 - Develop business cases and growth strategies: Build financial models, investment recommendations, and actionable business plans for new programs, partnerships, and market expansion. Evaluate build, buy, and partner opportunities.

 - Design new educational programs: Develop strategies and concepts for accredited schools, full-time and part-time tuition programs, homeschool solutions, bundled learning experiences, and other educational pathways. Define target audiences, positioning, packaging, pricing, enrollment models, and financial objectives.

 - Expand public funding opportunities: Develop strategies to expand Outschool's participation in ESAs, the Federal Scholarship Tax Credit, state funding programs, and other emerging education funding opportunities. Identify priority markets and opportunities to make Outschool's offerings accessible to more families.

 - Support public funding partnerships: Work with Business Development to establish, maintain, and expand relationships with state funding programs, ESA wallet providers, scholarship organizations, program administrators, and other strategic partners. Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, Product, and Operations to support ongoing program eligibility and successful participation.

 - Develop accreditation and tuition-based program strategies: Partner with Outschool's Head of Schools and private school leadership to evaluate academic models, accreditation pathways, program requirements, and expansion opportunities. Work with school leadership and organizations such as WASC, Cognia, and NCAA to support accreditation, recognition, and program eligibility.

 - Lead cross-functional program development and launches: Coordinate closely with Product, Business Development, Marketing, School Leadership, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Operations to translate opportunities into business requirements, development plans, and successful program launches.

 - Drive revenue growth: Establish revenue forecasts, enrollment targets, launch milestones, and performance measures for new programs and growth initiatives. Monitor results and work across teams to improve program design, pricing, packaging, customer adoption, and commercial performance.

 - Establish strategic priorities and roadmaps: Develop and maintain an integrated roadmap for public funding expansion, accredited programs, and new educational offerings. Present business cases, strategic recommendations, and progress updates to executive leadership.

Desired Experience & Skills:

 - 8+ years of experience in business strategy, growth, new program development, product strategy, or related roles within K–12 education, edtech, educational services, or adjacent industries.

 - Demonstrated success identifying market opportunities, developing business models, and bringing new products, programs, or services to market.

 - Strong analytical and financial skills, including market sizing, TAM analysis, competitive research, pricing strategy, unit economics, and business case development.

 - Understanding of ESAs, public education funding, accreditation, tuition-based education, and alternative K–12 learning models.

 - Experience developing, designing, launching, or scaling educational offerings, programs, or new business initiatives.

 - Ability to develop strategic partnerships and work effectively with external organizations, education agencies, and program administrators.

 - Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to influence priorities, coordinate teams, and drive initiatives from concept through launch without direct reporting authority.

 - Entrepreneurial mindset, strong commercial judgment, and a demonstrated ability to turn strategic opportunities into measurable revenue growth.

Other Considerations:

 - Experience with accredited online schools, private school networks, homeschool programs, microschools, or hybrid education models.

 - Direct experience with ESA programs, scholarship-granting organizations, state education agencies, or publicly funded education programs.

 - Familiarity with accreditation organizations such as WASC, Cognia, or NEASC, and NCAA academic eligibility requirements.

 - Experience designing program bundles, pricing models, and tuition-based educational offerings.

 - Experience evaluating strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and build-buy-partner opportunities.

 - Previous experience in startups, high-growth education organizations, or consumer marketplaces.

Compensation:

Outschool recruits across the US and Canada, and sets employee salaries to reflect local compensation and cost of living. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for equity and benefits. Additional details are provided during the interview process.

This role is available in the following US Pay Zones:

US Tiers

US Tier 1: San Francisco Bay Area, New York City, and Seattle Metro

US Tier 2: All California excluding San Francisco Bay Area, Boston Metro, Chicago Metro, Denver Metro, Austin Metro, Portland Metro

US Tier 3: All other cities and states

US Pay Zones

US Tier 1: This position is not available in this pay zone

US Tier 2: $183,600 - $207,000

US Tier 3: $162,000 - $182,250

Benefits & Culture:

At Outschool, we believe that taking care of one another enables us to do our best work. To us that means:

 - Shared Financial Success: Competitive salaries, stock options, and retirement plans.

 - Health: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance.

 - Wellness: Annual wellness stipend, access to coaching & therapy, and pet wellness plans.

 - PTO & Family Benefits: Generous PTO and family leave policies.

 - Hybrid & Remote-Friendly: Outschool has a distributed team across the U.S. and Canada and an office in San Francisco. Bay Area-based employees work in the office part of the week and receive commute-related benefits. Team members outside the Bay Area remain fully remote, with support for expensable home office setup and internet to stay connected no matter where you are.

 - Lifelong Learners: Annual budgets for professional development and DEI learning; budgets for children to take Outschool classes.

 - Community Impact: Outschool matches employee donations to eligible charities and supports Outschool.org http://Outschool.org’s nonprofit programs.

Outschool is an equal opportunity employer. We view diversity as a moral imperative and competitive advantage. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We plan and structure our interviews to directly assess skills and experience.
